summary: "Come to Leicester" is the brand name of an annual self-guided artist studio tour held every third weekend of August in Leicester, NC, not a standing membership association. Its own website describes it as an annual community event where a rotating "community of artists" open their studios to the public; there is no mention of dues, a member roster, or an organizing club, and a PayPal link is for "Artist and Sponsor Payments" (participation fees), similar to a fair or vendor event.

evidence.note: The official site explicitly frames it as "an annual community event rather than a formal standing organization," held the third weekend in August, with no membership system described.
Artists "voluntarily participate" and pay via a PayPal link for "Artist and Sponsor Payments," more like paid tour/vendor participation than club dues.
Event description calls it "the annual Come to Leicester studio tour," a self-guided tour of open studios and community hubs, with no membership language.

The DB has several other 'Come to Leicester' branded events (a vineyard tomato pop-up, live music, a food truck) the same weekend, showing the name labels a community festival weekend, not a single club's activity.

No separate Facebook group, Meetup, or Instagram presence was found beyond a Facebook page whose title is simply 'Come To Leicester Studio Tour,' consistent with an event page rather than a community group page.
